fields.description: The position of the HGB-Taxonomie, without the prefix de-gaap-ci, such as bs.ass.currAss.cashEquiv.bank.
fields.label: Position

fields.description: The label of the position in the HGB-Taxonomie, which saving fills in once the taxonomy is installed.
fields.label: Label of the Position

fields.description: Where a balance on the other side of the position goes, such as bs.eqLiab.liab.bank.other for a bank account with a credit balance.
fields.label: Position for the Opposite Balance

fields.description: As the DATEV charts mark accounts for the Handelsbilanz (HB) or the Steuerbilanz (SB) only: the balance counts in the balance sheets of the purpose.
fields.label: Abschlusszweck

fields.description: Ausleihungen, Forderungen and Verbindlichkeiten owed to or by the shareholders, which the Jahresabschluss notes (§ 42 Abs. 3 GmbHG).
fields.label: Owed to or by Shareholders

fields.description: The remaining term of a Forderung or Verbindlichkeit, which the Jahresabschluss notes (§ 268 Abs. 4 and 5 HGB).
fields.label: Remaining Term
fields.options:
up to one year
one to five years
over five years

fields.description: Accounts of the same netting group, such as Vorsteuer and Umsatzsteuer towards the Finanzamt, are netted: their combined balance decides whether all of them go to the position or to the position for the opposite balance (§ 246 Abs. 2 Satz 1 HGB, § 387 BGB, § 226 AO). Empty: the account keeps its own sign.
fields.label: Netting Group
